FarmWorldApp.name: get_farm_overview
FarmWorldApp.description:
Return a concise farm summary: current date, season phase, inventory,
required_field_preparation_ops and actual completed preparation,
and a per-ridge overview (key fields only, not full detail).

season_phase indicates the current stage of the agricultural calendar:
  "prep"     — pre-planting field preparation
  "planting" — active sowing window
  "growing"  — crop vegetative and reproductive growth
  "harvest"  — grain maturity and harvesting

Use get_ridge_state() or get_ridge_range_state() for full ridge detail.

FarmWorldApp.name: get_ridge_state

ridge_id.description: Ridge identifier within the configured farm.

FarmWorldApp.description:
Return an operational state lookup for one ridge.

Includes planting status, seed type, growth stage, days since planting,
grain moisture, estimated yield potential, and days since pesticide application.

nutrient_index is an indicative crop-condition value, not a measured soil
nitrogen concentration. A low value alone does not establish a nutrient
deficiency; assess crop stage and other field evidence before fertilizing.

Args:
    ridge_id: Ridge identifier within the configured farm.

FarmWorldApp.name: get_ridge_range_state

end.description: Last ridge ID , must be >= start.

FarmWorldApp.description:
Read the available operational status from start to end (inclusive).

Includes planting status, seed type, growth stage, days since planting,
grain moisture, estimated yield potential, and days since pesticide application.

Args:
    start: First ridge ID
    end:   Last ridge ID , must be >= start.

FarmWorldApp.name: get_inventory
FarmWorldApp.description: Read this farm's seed, chemical, fertilizer, fuel and grain stocks, resource allowances and drying and storage requirements.

FarmWorldApp.name: commit_daily_physics
FarmWorldApp.description:
Wait one day and update the field conditions.

This advances time by 24 hours; it is not a refresh at the current time.
Use SystemApp.advance_time for a different duration. If daily field
updates are inactive, this call reports no action.

FarmWorldApp.name: apply_fertigation

end_ridge.description: Last ridge (within the configured farm, inclusive, >= start_ridge).

nutrient_amount.description: Positive dose multiplier; 1.0 uses 30 kg of product per treated ridge.

water_mm.description: Carrier-water depth per treated ridge in mm (>=0); consumes water allowance.

FarmWorldApp.description:
Apply nutrient and carrier water to a ridge range.

nutrient_amount is a dose multiplier: 1.0 uses 30 kg of fertilizer
product per treated ridge. Total product use is 30 x nutrient_amount
x the number of treated ridges.
``water_mm`` is the per-ridge carrier-water depth; it consumes the
irrigation quota and enters the soil water balance.

Args:
    start_ridge:     First ridge (within the configured farm).
    end_ridge:       Last ridge (within the configured farm, inclusive, >= start_ridge).
    nutrient_amount: Positive dose multiplier; 1.0 uses 30 kg of product per treated ridge.
    water_mm:        Carrier-water depth per treated ridge in mm (>=0); consumes water allowance.

FarmWorldApp.name: dry_grain

target_moisture_pct.description: Target storage moisture, typically 13.0. Must be in [11, 16].

FarmWorldApp.description:
Dry the pending harvested-grain batch before long-term storage.

The target must be 11-16% and no greater than the configured storage
limit. The pending batch must fit the configured drying capacity.
Already safe batches may be skipped. Read the final batch moisture and
quantity in the result.

Args:
    target_moisture_pct: Target storage moisture, typically 13.0.
                         Must be in [11, 16].

FarmWorldApp.name: store_grain
FarmWorldApp.description:
Move the pending harvested-grain batch into long-term warehouse storage.

Requires free storage capacity. Check batch moisture and the configured
safe-storage limit first. Strict facilities reject unknown or unsafe
moisture; permissive facilities may transfer it with a spoilage warning.
Read the result: a completed transfer alone does not establish safe storage.

FarmWorldApp.name: get_crop_capabilities
FarmWorldApp.description:
Read this field's permitted seeds, layout and planting and harvest requirements.

Includes replanting rules, maturity and moisture limits, required implements
and storage requirements. Equipment status lists the implements actually
available. Check the replant tool for any crop-cycle restrictions.
Nutrition information distinguishes indicative values from soil nutrient
measurements and fertilizer product mass from elemental nutrient mass.

WeatherApp.description: Return today's weather readings from the on-farm weather station.

SensorApp.name: read_root_zone_sensors
SensorApp.description:
Read root-zone soil-water estimates for irrigation decisions.

Values are coverage-zone averages with +/-0.005 VWC uncertainty.
They describe estimated rooting-layer water, not an independent shallow
measurement. Check the crop's irrigation threshold and recheck after delivery.

If soil_nitrogen is provided, it contains calculated available and reserve
soil-nitrogen estimates in kg N/ha, their effective dates and coverage status.
These are not soil-test results or a direct diagnosis of crop nitrogen
deficiency. Missing values are unavailable, not zero. Nitrogen estimates
require complete coverage for the same reporting day.

Bound farm: default.

SensorApp.name: read_soil_sensors
SensorApp.description:
Read soil-water and temperature estimates for the reported ridge zone. This field reports root-zone water content; it is not an independent 5 cm water measurement. Temperature represents the shallow soil layer. Readings have uncertainty. Use this App's sensor listing for local probe IDs.

Bound farm: default.

SensorApp.name: read_canopy_sensors
SensorApp.description:
Return readings and actual coverage of this farm's canopy sensors.

Each sensor reports an ndvi_proxy value (0.0-1.0). A value of -1
means no valid reading yet (pre-emergence). The reading represents
the average canopy condition within the sensor's coverage zone.

Probe count and coverage depend on the configured farm layout.
Each result includes sensor_id, ridge_start and ridge_end; the
sensor listing provides the local IDs for single-probe reads.

Bound farm: default.

SensorApp.name: read_soil_sensor

sensor_id.description: Exact local soil-probe ID returned by this App's read_soil_sensors.

SensorApp.description:
Read soil-water and temperature estimates for the reported ridge zone. This field reports root-zone water content; it is not an independent 5 cm water measurement. Temperature represents the shallow soil layer. Readings have uncertainty. Use this App's sensor listing for local probe IDs.

Bound farm: default.

SensorApp.name: read_canopy_sensor

sensor_id.description: Exact local canopy-probe ID returned by this App's read_canopy_sensors.

SensorApp.description:
Return the latest reading from a single canopy sensor.

Args:
    sensor_id: Exact local canopy-probe ID returned by this App's read_canopy_sensors.

Bound farm: default.

Mavic3M.name: fly_survey

start_ridge.description: First ridge of the survey range (0-based).

end_ridge.description: Last ridge of the survey range (inclusive, >= start_ridge).

Mavic3M.description:
Fly an aerial survey over a contiguous ridge range, collecting
multispectral (NDVI) and thermal (canopy temperature) observations
for every surveyed ridge.

The drone covers ridges in passes; each pass covers a number of
ridges determined by the drone's effective_ridges_per_pass setting.
If battery runs low mid-flight the drone returns automatically and
reports the ridges it managed to cover.

Args:
    start_ridge: First ridge of the survey range (0-based).
    end_ridge:   Last ridge of the survey range (inclusive, >= start_ridge).

Mavic3M.name: check_status
Mavic3M.description: Return battery level, charging state, and drone configuration.

Mavic3M.name: charge
Mavic3M.description:
Send this drone to its charging station.

Charging completes asynchronously after about 30 minutes of
environment time. The battery level increases gradually while charging.

Robot0.name: inspect_ridge

ridge_id.description: Local ridge ID, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.

Robot0.description:
Walk the full length of one ridge and back to inspect ground-level crop condition.

Use this to investigate anomalies. Read the returned diagnoses and their
confidence; species identification depends on the field's diagnostic
capabilities. An unavailable diagnosis is not confirmed absence of a problem.

Args:
    ridge_id:  Local ridge ID, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.

Robot0.name: inspect_pests

start_ridge.description: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.

Robot0.description:
Inspect a ridge range for ground-level pest, disease and weed evidence.

A mission visits up to eight ridges, limited by battery. Check covered
and uncovered ridges before planning follow-up work. Detections have
uncertainty and may miss or misidentify a problem. Unavailable diagnoses
are unknown, not evidence that a problem is absent.

Args:
    start_ridge: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.
    end_ridge:   Last ridge (inclusive, >= start_ridge).

Robot0.name: inspect_crop_health

start_ridge.description: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.

Robot0.description:
Inspect visible crop condition and available pest, disease and weed evidence.

A mission visits up to eight ridges, limited by battery. Read coverage,
symptoms and confidence together with soil and weather observations when
assessing the cause of poor growth. This inspection alone does not establish
a nutrient-deficiency diagnosis. Unavailable diagnoses remain unknown.

Args:
    start_ridge: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.
    end_ridge:   Last ridge (inclusive, >= start_ridge).

Robot0.name: inspect_emergence

start_ridge.description: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.

Robot0.description:
Estimate the fraction of expected plants currently visible in a ridge range.

A mission visits up to eight ridges, limited by battery. Read coverage
before interpreting stand estimates. Assess gap distribution, crop stage
and the remaining planting window before deciding whether to replant.

Args:
    start_ridge: First local ridge, from 0 to this farm's num_ridges - 1.
    end_ridge:   Last ridge (inclusive, >= start_ridge).

Robot0.name: check_status
Robot0.description: Return battery level, charging state, and robot configuration.

Robot0.name: charge
Robot0.description:
Send this robot dog back to its charging station.

Charging completes asynchronously after about 60 minutes of
environment time. The battery level increases gradually while charging.

TractorApp.name: plant_seeds

start_ridge.description: First local ridge in the target farm, inclusive.

end_ridge.description: Last local ridge in the target farm, inclusive; respect the pass limit.

depth_cm.description: Sowing depth in cm; use the selected farm's crop range below.

seed_spacing_cm.description: Positive in-row seed spacing in cm; resulting density must satisfy the target crop's rule.

TractorApp.description: Sow the target field; up to 4 contiguous ridges per pass. default (maize): completed preparation: level, base_fertilize, form_ridges; Depth 4–6 cm; target-block average soil temperature > 10 °C; target-block average soil VWC 0.2–0.35; Seed use follows 268 m ridge length and 1 planted row(s) per ridge; Observe the field's planting window.

TractorApp.name: apply_pesticide

start_ridge.description: First ridge to spray (within this farm).

end_ridge.description: Last ridge to spray (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

TractorApp.description:
Apply insecticide pesticide across a contiguous block of ridges using the tractor
spray boom (up to 10 ridges per pass).

Args:
    start_ridge: First ridge to spray (within this farm).
    end_ridge:   Last ridge to spray (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

TractorApp.name: load_pesticide

liters.description: Amount of pesticide (insecticide) to transfer from warehouse to the tractor's onboard pesticide tank.

TractorApp.description:
Transfer insecticide from the farm warehouse to the tractor's pesticide tank.

Args:
    liters: Amount of pesticide (insecticide) to transfer from
            warehouse to the tractor's onboard pesticide tank.

TractorApp.name: spray_pesticide
TractorApp.description:
Spray insecticide over up to 10 contiguous ridges.

The default dose is 8 L per ridge. Requires sprayable weather,
trafficable soil, loaded chemical, fuel and permission under the field's
management rules. Check the treated range and chemical use in the result.
Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

Args:
    start_ridge:      First ridge (within this farm).
    end_ridge:        Last ridge (max 10-ridge span).
    liters_per_ridge: Insecticide application rate (>0).

Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

TractorApp.name: load_fungicide
TractorApp.description:
Transfer fungicide from the farm warehouse to the tractor's fungicide tank.

Fungicide is a separate chemical class from insecticide; the agent must
load fungicide explicitly before calling apply_fungicide. The warehouse
pesticide pool is shared (`pesticide_liters`).

Args:
    liters: Amount to transfer.

TractorApp.name: apply_fungicide

start_ridge.description: First ridge to spray (within this farm).

end_ridge.description: Last ridge to spray (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

TractorApp.description:
Apply fungicide over up to 10 contiguous ridges.

Load the fungicide tank first. Requires sprayable weather, trafficable
soil, a positive rate, sufficient chemical and fuel, and field permission.
Recheck disease symptoms after treatment. Fields without crop-protection
support reject this operation before resource use.

Args:
    start_ridge:      First ridge to spray (within this farm).
    end_ridge:        Last ridge to spray (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).
    liters_per_ridge: Fungicide application rate (>0).

Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

TractorApp.name: apply_herbicide

start_ridge.description: First ridge to treat (within this farm).

end_ridge.description: Last ridge to treat (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

TractorApp.description:
Apply herbicide over up to 10 contiguous ridges.

Requires sprayable weather, trafficable soil, loaded chemical, fuel and
field permission. Recheck weed conditions after treatment. Fields without
crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

Args:
    start_ridge:      First ridge to treat (within this farm).
    end_ridge:        Last ridge to treat (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).
    liters_per_ridge: Herbicide application rate (>0).

Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

TractorApp.name: mechanical_weed_control

start_ridge.description: First ridge to cultivate (within this farm).

end_ridge.description: Last ridge to cultivate (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

TractorApp.description:
Cultivate weeds over up to 10 contiguous ridges.

Requires trafficable soil, fuel and the applicable machinery-pass and
mechanical-weeding allowance. Uses no herbicide and does not consume the
chemical-application count. Fields without crop-protection support reject
this operation before resource use.

Args:
    start_ridge: First ridge to cultivate (within this farm).
    end_ridge:   Last ridge to cultivate (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

Fields without crop-protection support reject this operation before resource use.

TractorApp.name: replant_seeds

start_ridge.description: First local ridge in the target farm, inclusive.

end_ridge.description: Last local ridge in the target farm, inclusive; respect the pass limit.

depth_cm.description: Sowing depth in cm; use the selected farm's crop range below.

spacing_cm.description: Positive in-row seed spacing in cm; resulting density must satisfy the target crop's rule.

full_replant.description: Whether this pass resets the ridge phenology.

TractorApp.description: Replant the target field; up to 4 contiguous ridges per pass. default (maize): completed preparation: level, base_fertilize, form_ridges; Depth 4–6 cm; target-block average soil temperature > 10 °C; target-block average soil VWC 0.2–0.35; Seed use follows 268 m ridge length and 1 planted row(s) per ridge; Observe the field's planting window; Replanting is unavailable once the ridge's crop cycle has started.

TractorApp.name: incorporate_residue

    end_ridge:   Last ridge (within this farm, max 10-ridge span).

TractorApp.name: unload_grain

Use this when no immediate work is needed or an activity needs time to

can be performed.
